2. This criminal appeal under Section 14-A(2) of The Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes
(Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989

has been preferred by the appellant with the prayer to allow the
appeal, set aside the bail rejection order dated 05.07.2025 passed by learned Special Judge
(S.C./S.T.Act), Kushinagar arising out of Case Crime No.0051 of 2025, under Sections 64, 87, 352,
351(2),127(2) B.N.S. & 3(1)(?), 3(1)(?) and 3(2)(v) Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribes (Prevention
of Cruelty) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015), at Police Station Ravindranagar Dhoos, District
Kushinagar.

sentences.text: However, victim has again lodged an FIR on the similar allegations against appellant.

It was contended by learned counsel for appellant that victim herself is a married lady,
mother of two children, and has still not obtained divorce from her earlier husband.
Therefore, her allegation against appellant that he made false promise to marry cannot be sustained.
Hence, the appellant is entitled for bail.

4. Learned AGA for State and learned counsel for informant have opposed the aforesaid prayer of the learned counsel for appellant and have submitted that at the time when compromise was submitted by victim in Session Trial No.756 of 2024, she was not in conscious state to take a proper decision.
Moreover, she has obtained divorce six months before the alleged incident and the Case Crime No.281 of 2024 has not been settled on the basis of alleged compromise filed on behalf of victim.
Hence, the appellant is not entitled for bail.
5. I have considered the rival submissions so made and have gone through the entire record.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, the Court is of the opinion that the appellants have made out a case for bail.
7. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.

8. Let the appellant- Abhay Jaiswal involved in Case Crime No.0051 of 2025, under Sections 64, 87,
352, 351(2),127(2) B.N.S. & 3(1)(?), 3(1)(?) and 3(2)(v) Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribes (Prevention of Cruelty) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015), at Police Station Ravindranagar Dhoos,
District Kushinagar, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
